transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel worn out all the time. Um... even after I get a full night in bed, it's like my body is made of sandbags. Just getting through a normal workday, or even trying to fold the laundry at home... it takes absolutely everything I have right now.
Along with this exhaustion, have you been feeling down, sad, or hopeless?

Yeah, I have. Most days, I wake up with this heavy, just... flat feeling right in my chest. I'll sit at the kitchen table in the morning, just staring out at the yard, and... I don't know, I just feel like there is no good version of the future coming. So, yes, definitely feeling down and hopeless.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Um, I'd say this depressed, just... slowed-down and exhausted feeling has been going on for about two months now. Yeah, it's been pretty much most days for the past two months.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, hyper, or like you didn't need much sleep?

Yeah, I have. Um... I remember, in the first few weeks right after we signed the mortgage papers, I felt almost... lit up, I guess. Like I was just unstoppable. But it wasn't all just good energy. One minute I'd feel like that, and then the next minute I'd be snapping at my husband, or getting short with my coworkers over really tiny delays. So, yes, I definitely have felt the opposite of how I feel now.
During that time after signing the mortgage, about how long did that surge of high energy and irritability last continuously?

I'm not exactly sure how long it lasted continuously. It's hard to put an exact number of days on it. It was definitely a noticeable period right after we bought the house, but... yeah, I couldn't say exactly how long it went on without a break.
During that high-energy period, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual to feel rested?

No, not really. I mean, I was definitely wound up during the day, but... I don't remember needing less sleep. I think I still slept my normal hours, or at least tried to. I definitely didn't have that thing where you only sleep a couple of hours and wake up feeling completely fine, if that's what you mean.
During that time when you felt wound up and energetic, did you notice your thoughts racing or jumping very quickly from one idea to another?

No, I don't think I experienced that. Um... I mean, I definitely had a lot on my mind with the new house and work, but my thoughts didn't feel like they were racing out of control or anything. I don't remember them jumping from one idea to another really fast. My mind actually felt pretty clear, just... busy, I guess. But not racing.
During that time, did you or anyone close to you notice that you were talking much more or much faster than you usually do?

No, I don't think so. My husband never mentioned anything about me talking too fast or talking over him, and I didn't feel like I was talking more than usual. I think I was communicating pretty normally, really. I definitely wasn't talking a mile a minute or anything like that.
